notes.title: New Update 1.1.0
notes.notes: [p]We present to you the first full-fledged update, with the addition of a new game mode.[/p][h3]What's New:[/h3][list][*][p]Singleplayer mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Records are now separated by difficulty levels and game modes.[/p][/*][*][p]Added AZERTY support. On first launch, players with French localization will have the AZERTY layout selected by default. The current layout can be changed in the settings: Video/Screen/Layout.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Minor Fixes:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where menu buttons would disappear if "Back" was pressed on the main button layer.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted collisions on a level.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the checkpoint sequence on "Hard" difficulty.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to use cooperative jump throughout the entire location.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.5 (Old Version)
notes.notes:
[p]Due to the recent major update, we received feedback from you that the Multiplayer mode is not working for some.
[/p][p align="start"]We are forced to temporarily roll back the new version of the game and are now urgently fixing these issues to eventually release a full update that won’t disrupt the gameplay.
[/p][h3]We appreciate your understanding, thank you![/h3]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2
notes.notes: [h2]Changelog[/h2][list][*][p]Added the option to join the studio’s Discord directly from the main menu.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the pause menu was accessible during level loading.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The pause menu now shows the current difficulty level instead of the game version.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1
notes.notes: [h2][b]Fix List[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed incorrect localization text in several UI elements.[/p][/*][*][p]Closed several spots where players could get stuck and lose progress.[/p][/*][/list][h2][/h2][h2][b]Change List[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Added several checkpoints on "Medium" difficulty.[/p][/*][*][p]Added difficulty level descriptions in the lobby.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the size of steering wheels.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Tomorrow is release day!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Tomorrow, Try To Drive launches —[/b] a co-op game where you and your friend control one bike together.
[/p][p]What’s waiting for you❓ Lots of laughter, unexpected moments, and a real test of friendship. One player steers, the other hits the gas — and every turn becomes a little adventure.
[/p][p]🎉 [b]Release is tomorrow, September 11.[/b]
[/p][h3]Add the game to your wishlist so you don’t miss it![/h3]
